CHATTOGRAM, Aug, 10, 2022 (BSS) - Information and Broadcasting Minister Dr Hasan Mahmud today said 90 percent agriculture has been mechanized in the country over the last 10 years.

"As a result, more than one billion US dollars is being earned through exporting agricultural products annually and the government has a plan to increase it further in future," he said.

The minister was virtually inaugurating the 'Agricultural Technology Fair' held at Rangunia Upazila Parishad Auditorium this aftern
